title: Influence and boundary fraction
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The influence of $f$ in coordinate $i$ equals the fraction of points on the face where coordinate $i$ is $+1$ for which flipping coordinate $i$ changes the value of $f$.
